reason: The initial prose mistakenly treated each of the six positions as the Bernoulli denominator and centered at 1/49. The modeled event is number inclusion in a draw, whose exact null probability is 6/49.

supersedesModelFields.ownDeviation: For each number n and target draw t, posteriorMean_n - 6/49, where posteriorMean_n=(count_n + priorStrength*(6/49))/(window + priorStrength). count_n is the number of prior draws in the frozen same-game window containing n.
supersedesModelFields.ownZ: (posteriorMean_n - 6/49) / sqrt((6/49)*(43/49)/(window+priorStrength)). This scale is used for ranking only.
supersedesModelFields.otherZ: Apply the identical formula to the other 6-of-49 game using only its draws with drawDate strictly earlier than the target date and the same frozen window/priorStrength.
supersedesModelFields.score: ownZ + crossWeight*otherZ; crossWeight=0 remains the nested same-game control.
